summary: Phase 3 backend testing complete. Full regression of iteration_1 (33 tests) + iteration_2 (20 tests) PASSES unchanged after the big router-split refactor. Added 18 new tests covering POST /api/patients/{id}/ai/recap (RBAC, doctor scope, audit logging, edge cases). Grand total: 71/71 PASS (100%).
critical_code_review_comments: Refactor is clean: server.py reduced to 64 lines, all routers <220 lines (largest cases.py = 212). Past iteration_2's main complaint (single 1154-line file) is fully resolved.
routers/ai.py _call_llm helper is shared between per-case and per-patient endpoints — good DRY. Async correct.

AI recap doctor-scope filter (q['assigned_doctor_id'] = user.get('doctor_id') when role==DOCTOR) is correctly applied BEFORE the empty check, so Hemanth gets 404 'No accessible visits' for Jyothi-only patients — verified by test.
Audit log payload {action: 'recap', visits: N} is written and asserted from /admin/audit-logs — works.

Minor: ai/recap caps cases at 200 (.to_list(200)). For chronic-disease patients with >200 visits this silently truncates without flagging in the response. Consider returning a 'truncated' flag or surfacing total_visits separately when len(cases)==200.

Minor: AI prompt body concatenation does not strip carriage returns or LLM injection patterns from complaint_text. Patients with malicious content in their complaint could attempt prompt injection. Low risk for an internal clinic tool, but worth a sanitization pass.

Carry-over from iteration_2 (still applicable, not blockers): send_whatsapp/send_sms still use sync requests.post inside async path; attachment delete is soft-only; CSV exports load full to_list before streaming; attachment upload reads full body before 10MB check. None blocking but worth scheduling.

Twilio + WhatsApp credentials still unconfigured (intentional per problem statement). /api/health correctly reports providers.{whatsapp:false, sms:false} and reminder send-now returns FAILED with PROVIDER_NOT_CONFIGURED.

Each case has clinical notes + 1 prescription. No teardown — TEST_ prefix preserved for next iteration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Three test files now form the complete backend regression: test_sparsa_backend.py (33), test_sparsa_round2.py (20), test_sparsa_recap.py (18). Run all together: `pytest backend/tests/ -v` — completes in ~70s. The recap endpoint validates: doctor scope (DOCTOR sees only own cases, OWNER_DOCTOR/ADMIN see all), 404 for missing patient, 404 for no-accessible-visits, 403 for RECEPTION/PHARMACY/PRO, and AI_USED/Patient/recap audit log entry with metadata.visits matching visits_analysed. AI calls go through real Claude Sonnet 4.5 via EMERGENT_LLM_KEY — each recap takes ~2-4s. Twilio/WhatsApp still intentionally unconfigured.
